Setting up coding agents for StimGate

Source: vignettes/coding-agents.Rmd
coding-agents.Rmd

Set up a cloud coding agent with the repository’s scripts or workflow, then check that StimGate loads. Agents must read AGENTS.md before changing code; it defines coding conventions and required checks.

Choose the setup

Agent Configuration in this repository
OpenAI Codex Cloud scripts/agents/setup-codex.sh and scripts/agents/maintenance-codex.sh
Google Jules scripts/agents/setup-jules.sh
GitHub Copilot coding agent .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml

Keep setup changes in these files. If a platform requires pasted script text, copy the current repository file rather than maintaining another version.

Shared environment rules

  • Cloud library: set persistent CI=true so .Rprofile skips renv. Use the installed development library; missing packages indicate a setup problem. Do not run renv::restore() in these cloud environments.
  • Local library: ordinary local development still uses the project’s renv profiles when a reproducible library is needed.
  • Dependencies: Codex/Jules scripts target R 4.6 and Bioconductor 3.23. They install system libraries, Quarto, DESCRIPTION development dependencies, and tools including devtools, rcmdcheck, roxygen2, styler, lintr, covr and pkgdown.
  • Analysis support: Codex/Jules also install Python/NumPy, simcyto, future, furrr, progressr, reticulate and cytoUtils. F-beta comparisons use Python through reticulate.
  • simcyto: use unpinned SATVILab/simcyto for development, including Copilot and analysis CI. Pin a SHA only for a task that requires historical reproduction or a version-specific regression check.
  • Validation: the scripts check required packages and devtools::load_all(). Codex/Jules repair failed installation stages before these final checks; an intermediate failure alone does not establish that setup failed.

Codex/Jules use this Posit CRAN URL for Linux binaries:

https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/noble/latest

Keep the __linux__ form used by the scripts. The /bin/linux/... form has been classified as a source repository by pak, causing ordinary CRAN packages to compile from source.

OpenAI Codex Cloud

Use the universal container image, Manual setup and container caching. Configure CI=true as a persistent environment variable: setup runs in a separate shell, so an export there does not reach later agent commands. See the OpenAI environment guide for platform settings.

Setup script:

bash scripts/agents/setup-codex.sh

Maintenance script:

bash scripts/agents/maintenance-codex.sh

Maintenance installs newly declared development dependencies, refreshes SATVILab/simcyto, ensures repository tools remain available, and checks that StimGate loads.

Network access

For task-time documentation lookup or dependency downloads, enable agent internet access with Common dependencies and add the domains needed below. Allow additional HTTP methods only when required, for example for Git-over-HTTPS operations. See the OpenAI internet-access guide for allowlist controls.

github.com
api.github.com
codeload.github.com
raw.githubusercontent.com
objects.githubusercontent.com
r-lib.github.io
cloud.r-project.org
cran.r-project.org
r-project.org
packagemanager.posit.co
p3m.dev
bioconductor.org

Keep task-time access limited to needed domains. Setup scripts have internet access for installing dependencies.

Google Jules

Use this setup command:

bash scripts/agents/setup-jules.sh

The script expects the checkout under /app and exports CI=true during installation. If Jules offers persistent project environment variables, also set CI=true there for later R sessions.

Use the same package-source domains listed above if network controls are available. Rebuilding installs unpinned SATVILab/simcyto; to refresh a long-lived environment, rerun setup or use the refresh command under Troubleshooting.

GitHub Copilot coding agent

Configure Copilot through .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml. It installs Linux system libraries, the current R release with Posit Package Manager, package/development dependencies, devtools, rcmdcheck, decor, unpinned SATVILab/simcyto and Quarto. Its verification step checks core packages and loads StimGate.

.Rprofile recognises Copilot as CI and skips renv. Use its installed library directly.

When adding a dependency:

  1. Put package dependencies in DESCRIPTION.
  2. Add agent-only tools to the workflow when Copilot tasks need them.
  3. Keep SATVILab/simcyto unpinned, as in analysis CI.
  4. Extend verification when a missing dependency should fail setup.

Keep configuration in the workflow; add a separate installer only if the workflow cannot express the required setup.

Check a coding task

Run commands from the repository root. Follow the full checklist in AGENTS.md; common package checks are:

Rscript -e "devtools::load_all(); devtools::test()"

When changing analysis/ or scripts/r/, also run:

Rscript analysis/tests/run_analysis_tests.R

The GitHub Actions workflows provide a smaller baseline for agents that only need package tests. Narrow documentation or package tasks may not need Quarto or the comparison stack; the full Codex/Jules setup covers research analyses too.

Troubleshooting

Symptom Check or action
R activates renv Check task-time CI=true, not just the setup export. For Copilot, check .Rprofile still recognises its environment.
pak compiles many ordinary CRAN packages Inspect pak::repo_status(). Codex/Jules should use the __linux__/noble/latest URL above; check it was not replaced with /bin/linux/....
simcyto is stale Run Codex maintenance, or refresh with the R command below. For Copilot, check the workflow is unpinned and provision a new environment.
Bioconductor installation fails If final validation fails after repair, inspect the missing package’s system requirements. For Copilot, inspect the system-library and setup-r-dependencies steps.
StimGate loads but analysis tests fail Check analysis dependencies, including simcyto and comparison tools. Use full Codex/Jules setup, or add the needed dependency to Copilot’s workflow.

Refresh simcyto in an existing development library:

pak::pkg_install("SATVILab/simcyto", upgrade = TRUE, ask = FALSE)

Add another agent

  1. Add a small script under scripts/agents/, or use the platform’s repository workflow.
  2. Reuse the R/Bioconductor dependency strategy unless the platform has a suitable native equivalent.
  3. Keep repository conventions in AGENTS.md and add setup instructions to this guide.
  4. Avoid duplicating pinned dependency lists across configuration files.
